mapper.select: SELECT scope_type FROM role_data_scope WHERE role = #{role}
SELECT dimension, value FROM role_data_dimension_rule WHERE role = #{role} ORDER BY dimension, value
SELECT role FROM role_data_scope ORDER BY role
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO role_data_scope (role, scope_type, updated_at) VALUES (#{role}, #{scopeType}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE scope_type = VALUES(scope_type), updated_at = NOW()
INSERT INTO role_data_dimension_rule (role, dimension, value) VALUES (#{role}, #{dimension}, #{value})
mapper.select: SELECT country_key AS value, COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(country), '')), country_key) AS label FROM task_records WHERE deleted = 0 AND country_key IS NOT NULL AND country_key != '' GROUP BY country_key ORDER BY label, country_key LIMIT 500
